summary: Pai Airport (PYY) is a small domestic airport nestled in the mountains of northern Thailand, serving the backpacker haven of Pai in Mae Hong Son Province. The airport sits in a scenic valley and is famous for its dramatic approach through mountain ridges, often cited as one of the most thrilling landings in Thailand. It primarily handles short-hop flights from Bangkok operated by Kan Air and Nok Air, offering travelers a quick alternative to the winding 762-curve mountain road from Chiang Mai.
faqs:
Q: How long is the flight from Bangkok to Pai?
A: Approximately 1 hour and 20 minutes from Bangkok Don Mueang, compared to a 3-4 hour minivan ride from Chiang Mai.

Q: What airlines fly into Pai Airport?
A: Kan Air and Nok Air operate the Bangkok-Pai route, though schedules and carriers may vary by season.

Q: Is Pai Airport safe given its mountain location?
A: Yes, the airport operates with proper certification and pilots are trained for the mountainous approach, though flights can be delayed or cancelled due to fog during the rainy season.
transport_tips: The airport is only about 1.5 km from Pai town center, so most travelers simply walk or take a short motorbike taxi to their guesthouse. Songthaews (shared pickup trucks) also run between the airport and town for a small fare. Note that Pai has no public transport system, so renting a motorbike or scooter upon arrival is the standard way to explore the surrounding countryside.
local_tip: Book a seat on the left side of the plane when flying from Bangkok for the best views of the mountains and valleys during the spectacular landing approach into Pai.
